pages.text: Chishi equipment is the final armament of Chishi technology:$(br)$(li)Chishi Energy Aggregator: 10M Chi + 1 Netherite Ingot → 1 Chishi Ingot$(br)$(li)Chishi Equipment Forger: Chi + Chishi Ingot + Netherite equipment → Chishi equipment$(br)$(li)Chishi Upgrade Station: spend Upgrade Templates and upgrade slots to strengthen gear$(br2)Chishi equipment has 1.25x the armor and toughness of Netherite, and each piece starts with 4 upgrade slots.
